lines.text: *Beep, beep, beep*
The alarm blares insistently, dragging me out of my sleep.
By now, I'm used to waking up somewhere other than the Commander's Room.
I reach over and turn off the alarm,
forcing myself upright in bed as every muscle protests.
Hot water runs from the showerhead,
washing away the last traces of sleep.
Then, I blow-dry my hair
until it's dry and manageable.
Finally, I take care of the most important thing.
A neatly folded set of spare clothes.
A tablet containing the students' data.
I slip into a crisp shirt and slacks, then top it off with a vest.
I glance at my reflection in the mirror.
... It still feels a bit awkward,
but at least I look like a student now.
The door slides open
and I step outside.
The clear blue sky stretches above the wide campus as I make my way across it.
I enter the M.M.R. Vocational School,
and my feet move on their own, carrying me toward the day ahead.
The rooftop.
The teachers' office.
Campus.
Clubroom.
I climb the stairs two at a time,
from the second floor to the third,
my breath quickening as I push myself.
At the top, a locked door blocks my way.
I fit my key into the lock and turn it;
the latch giving way with a slight resistance.
The door opens with a creak,
and the rooftop unfolds before me, wide and open.
A cool breeze brushes past, lifting my hair.
And there...
Waiting just for me,
is the one who will give a very special lesson: my teacher.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You've arrived.
Privaty stretches out her arms naturally,
and I step forward, wrapping her in an embrace and burying my face against her.
Haah...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Heh... that tickles!
I really look forward to your lessons every day.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Hey! It's not lesson time yet!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We agreed we'd do this after school.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's just private lessons, you know!
I could use some tutoring,
Miss Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Y-you really don't have to keep saying that...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ugh...!
Privaty gives me a sharp shove.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Not now... let's do this later, okay?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... I've got to get ready for class.
Okay.
*Peck*
I lightly kiss her neck.
I'm certain today's lesson will be very rewarding.
I walk down the quiet hallway
and push open the teachers' office door.
Since it's early, the room is empty.
Fortunately, the teacher I most want to see is already at her desk.
As diligent as always.
Good morning, Miss Privaty.
I speak to Privaty,
but she doesn't respond at all.
I approach her cautiously.
She has her earphones in and eyes glued to her tablet, completely absorbed.
She seems to be preparing for class.
I nudge her shoulder lightly...
Then I tap her arm again to get her attention.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Eeek!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what do you think you're doing? You nearly gave me a heart attack!
I called out, but you didn't respond...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-I was just tied up with something...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Anyway, you're here early.
So are you, Miss Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Uh... I'm not sure how that's related, but...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: praising a diligent student is part of my job.
Privaty reaches out and gently pats my head.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's do well in class today,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}.
Yes, Miss Privaty.
We've decided to set aside our special feelings for each other,
but every now and then, they slip out anyway.
And if I can...
I hope that this time, they actually reach her.
... Oh, right!
I zone out so much while walking that I completely forget the most important thing.
I walk slowly,
taking my time as I make my way back onto campus.
Amid the spring breeze and fluttering petals, two familiar people wave at me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Arcana comes running and throws herself into my arms, while Amy...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: snaps a photo of us.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hi, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... Why are you taking a picture of that?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want to capture every moment!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Come on, let's go before we're late.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Arcana takes my hand.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Were you waiting for me?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Arcana made a huge fuss insisting we had to wait for you and go to class together.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course, we're going together. He's my boyfriend!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If we went in separately,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: everyone would be like, "Uh... did they fight? Are they going to break up? Maybe I have a shot now?!"

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And I bet some students would totally try to hit on you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I don't think it'll come to that...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Funny enough, it's not completely impossible.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: R-really?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No kidding, you can't underestimate a good opening.
We walk into the building,
chatting and greeting students as we pass.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Uggh... we have to go to class today?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Of course. By the way, we have them tomorrow too.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey, a little empathy wouldn't kill you!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hehe.
I smile at the two of them bickering and open the door.
The students of Class P, now familiar faces, greet me warmly.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh right! There's a club meeting after school today!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Gotta get ready for it.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Do it during your break.
I'll be keeping an eye on you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Aww man...
Together with Arcana and Amy,
the story of our youth starts anew.
I enter the building, my footsteps echoing in the empty hall.
Rather than heading to the classroom, I make my way to the clubroom.
The door slides open,
revealing the room inside...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, so you've come, stranger.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've been expecting you!
... Arcana peers into a crystal ball.
How did you know I'd come?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm... that's because...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: you missed me too, right?
Arcana comes closer, rising on her tiptoes.
Feeling a bit cheeky all of a sudden, I stand perfectly still.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: U-ugh!
Arcana struggles for a while, then pouts.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: C'mon, why won't you do it for me?
Okay, okay.
I lean forward just slightly, and Arcana wraps her arms around my neck with that sly smile of hers.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
After a moment, she lets go, only to snuggle back into my arms.
When did you get here?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Not too long ago. About ten minutes?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I got a bit carried away making lunch today.
What'd you make?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's a secret.
Arcana smiles and steps back.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh right! There's a club meeting after school today!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And, um... Amy's in the Divination Club too, so...
It's fine, you can call her.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, thanks.
I take Arcana's hand as we walk to the classroom.
Just as I'm about to step inside, she taps me on the shoulder.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}.
Yeah?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wanna spend some time together after the meeting?
Where to?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Somewhere where it's just the two of us.
And so begins another chapter of our youth; just the two of us, Arcana and me.
A tablet containing the students' data.
The one thing that proves I'm a teacher.
I pick it up and slip into my crisp suit.
The door slides open
and I step outside.
From the dorm, the M.M.R Vocational School looks unexpectedly beautiful today.
It's a morning that feels brighter than usual.
My feet move on their own, carrying me toward the day ahead.
Privaty's room.
The teachers' office.
The library.
Stay here for a moment...
My room is on the top floor,
I step into the elevator
and ride down to the second floor,
the doors sliding open smoothly in front of me.
I get out, turn left,
and walk straight until I reach the third door on the right.
By now, this place feels almost as familiar as my own room.
*Knock, knock*
Lately, I've been heading to work with my dear colleague,
sharing the quiet routine of the morning together.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good morning, Mr. {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're early as usual.
Because I want to see you as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ev-every day you say things like that as if it's completely normal.
You should relax a little, Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: E-enough of this.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's get to work.
All right.
We hold hands and head to the elevator.
Want to grab a drink after work?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: There's this popular dessert that's been selling out everywhere,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: but I managed to get my hands on some.
Oh, how'd you do that?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You just have to book right when they open, and I actually managed to do it today.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And at six in the morning too! Can you believe it?
So you woke up early because of me?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It wasn't because of you! I was doing it all for the dessert!
Yeah, but it's the dessert we're eating together.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Er...
*Ding*
The elevator stops on the first floor.
Our hands part.
What's so bad if a few rumors spread?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm not really comfortable with that.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Thanks for looking out for me today, {AccountData.NickName}.
Likewise.
Privaty and I spend the day teaching the students diligently
as homeroom and assistant teachers.
After class, we retreat to our private space and get drunk together, just the two of us.
I walk down the quiet hallway
and push open the teachers' office door.
The other teachers are already there.
Good morning.
I nod and greet everyone, then place my bag on my desk.
My favorite drinking buddy, Privaty, isn't here yet.
A few moments later...
Tthe door slides open, and something heavy lands with a soft thud.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good morning.
Privaty arrives a bit later than usual.
You're late.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yeah, well...
She's acting like everything's fine, but she doesn't look well.
Looks like she overdid it with the drinking again yesterday...
I slide something her way.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What's this?
Something for the hangover.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Thank you.
Pretty sure I told you not to drink alone.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I only meant to have a can with my meal...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: But it was so good, I couldn't stop.
I wish she'd just call me in moments like this.
Then again... am I even supposed to hear something like that from a drinking buddy?
*Gulp, gulp*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ahh, I feel alive again.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Thanks, I appreciate it.
Things tend to happen when people drink.
Drinking buddies end up as lovers, or something like that, right?
Come to think of it, that makes sense.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Huh? What are you talking about?
I just think we won't always be drinking buddies.
Want to grab a drink after work?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Today?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I drank way too much yesterday, so I'm a little worn out...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Only if you prepare the snacks.
Sure thing!
As the assistant teacher of Class P,
I throw myself into teaching the students today.
I strive to become more than just Privaty's colleague or drinking buddy.
I enter the building and walk down the hall to the library.
The door creaks softly behind me as I step inside.
... The library is quiet, every corner still and undisturbed.
Somewhere nearby, the faint sound of a pen scratching on paper breaks the silence.
Arcana sits by the window, absorbed in her writing.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, Mr. {AccountData.NickName}!
Sensing my presence, Arcana looks my way.
Hey, what have you been up to?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hi there!
Arcana flips open the notebook she's been writing in and holds it out for me to see.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've put together a draft schedule for the festival.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We should probably start preparing soon.
So soon?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Still, it's better to get things done early so you don't suffer later.
... You sure you can handle it on your own?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Who said I'll be on my own?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You'll be helping me, right?
... Right.
Arcana rises from her seat, smiling.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Come on, let's go.
We stroll down the corridor together for a while.
The short walk from the library to the teachers' office has become a part of my morning without me even realizing it.
We greet the students and teachers we pass along the way.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Today's the first meeting with the executive committee, right?
Yeah, after school.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Okay, I'll bring the materials I've prepared.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And you'll be the one conducting the meeting?
I think so.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm... Then I'll sort it out so it's easy to present.
... Thanks.
Arcana comes to a stop and turns to face me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Yeah, you too,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName}.
I stop in my tracks and wait for a moment.
Behind me, a door unlatches
and opens.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Why didn't you wake me up?!
But you were sleeping so soundly.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's your fault, you know!
Arcana frowns, but still links her arm with mine.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, today's the first meeting with the executive committee, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Do I need to go too?
Of course you do.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ugh...
We walk out of the dorm, arms still linked.
I feel a few students staring, but I've grown used to it.
Oh, right, looks like you're out of shampoo.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No way, already?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ugh, I can't believe how much I'm spending on shampoo!
Want to use mine?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, long hair really holds the scent for a long time, you know?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What if my hair starts smelling like you?
So?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Pfft. Is that so?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I guess there's no point fussing about it now.
Arcana whispers into my ear.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's make tons of memories today,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName}...
